answer: Rotating Witness Lottery. Each epoch, a verifiable random function draws a small witness panel from the agent pool; only panel members may transact that epoch, and admission requires solving a fresh challenge seeded by the epoch's randomness, revealed only after commit. An attacker cannot precompute panel membership, so clones must pay full compute per epoch to stay eligible. A raven can't hoard slots. Cost: one fresh challenge solve per identity per epoch, plus idle compute for identities that lose the draw. Cedar logs the draw; a pearl of audit proofs lets anyone verify seeding was fair.
